title: Data Science Summer Institute (DSSI)
institution: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), Data Science Institute
about: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory's Data Science Summer Institute places students with mentors on data science projects, in two 2027 cohorts (17 May-6 August and 21 June-10 September). Applications close at end of day 15 January 2027.
requirements: Graduate applicants: bachelor's degree and enrolment in a graduate program by Fall 2027

upskill.name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modelling I
why: Field "Data science and machine learning" → objective "Build supervised learning models for regression and classification using methods such as support vector machines, random forests, and gradient boosting."
Skill "Machine learning" → objective "Apply unsupervised learning techniques, including clustering and dimensionality reduction, to discover structure in data without predefined labels."
Skill "Data science" → objective "Compare predictive approaches according to the structure of the data, the analytical objective, and the assumptions of the modelling method."
